classes.name: ShapeBuild
classes.summary: This package provides basic building tools for other packages in ShapeHealing. These tools are rather internal for ShapeHealing .

staticMethods.name: PlaneXOY
staticMethods.comment: Rebuilds a shape with substitution of some components Returns a {@link Geom_Surface | `Geom_Surface`} which is the Plane XOY (Z positive) This allows to consider an UV space homologous to a 3D space, with this support surface.

classes.name: ShapeBuild_Edge
classes.summary: This class provides low-level operators for building an edge 3d curve, copying edge with replaced vertices etc.

instanceMethods.name: CopyReplaceVertices
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, V1: TopoDS_Vertex, V2: TopoDS_Vertex): TopoDS_Edge
instanceMethods.comment: Copy edge and replace one or both its vertices to a given one(s). Vertex V1 replaces FORWARD vertex, and V2 - REVERSED, as they are found by {@link TopoDS_Iterator | `TopoDS_Iterator`}. If V1 or V2 is NULL, the original vertex is taken.

instanceMethods.name: CopyRanges
instanceMethods.signature: (toedge: TopoDS_Edge, fromedge: TopoDS_Edge, alpha?: number, beta?: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Copies ranges for curve3d and all common pcurves from edge <fromedge> into edge <toedge>.

instanceMethods.name: SetRange3d
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, first: number, last: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets range on 3d curve only.

instanceMethods.name: CopyPCurves
instanceMethods.signature: (toedge: TopoDS_Edge, fromedge: TopoDS_Edge): void
instanceMethods.comment: Makes a copy of pcurves from edge <fromedge> into edge <toedge>. Pcurves which are already present in <toedge>, are replaced by copies, other are copied. Ranges are also copied.

instanceMethods.name: Copy
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, sharepcurves?: boolean): TopoDS_Edge
instanceMethods.comment: Make a copy of <edge> by call to `CopyReplaceVertices()` (i.e. construct new TEdge with the same pcurves and vertices). If <sharepcurves> is False, pcurves are also replaced by their copies with help of method CopyPCurves.

instanceMethods.name: RemovePCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, face: TopoDS_Face): void
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Face.

instanceMethods.name: RemovePCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, surf: Geom_Surface): void
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Surface.

instanceMethods.name: RemovePCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, surf: Geom_Surface, loc: TopLoc_Location): void
instanceMethods.comment: Removes the PCurve(s) which could be recorded in an Edge for the given Surface, with given Location.

instanceMethods.name: ReplacePCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, pcurve: Geom2d_Curve, face: TopoDS_Face): void
instanceMethods.comment: Replace the PCurve in an Edge for the given Face In case if edge is seam, i.e. has 2 pcurves on that face, only pcurve corresponding to the orientation of the edge is replaced.

instanceMethods.name: ReassignPCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (edge: TopoDS_Edge, old: TopoDS_Face, sub: TopoDS_Face): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Reassign edge pcurve lying on face <old> to another face . If edge has two pcurves on <old> face, only one of them will be reassigned, and other will left alone. Similarly, if edge already had a pcurve on face , it will have two pcurves on it. Returns True if succeeded, False if no pcurve lying on <old> found.

instanceMethods.name: TransformPCurve
instanceMethods.signature: (pcurve: Geom2d_Curve, trans: gp_Trsf2d, uFact: number, aFirst: number, aLast: number): { returnValue: Geom2d_Curve; aFirst: number; aLast: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.returnType: { returnValue: Geom2d_Curve; aFirst: number; aLast: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Transforms the PCurve with given matrix and affinity U factor.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `aFirst`: updated value from the call.
- `aLast`: updated value from the call.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

classes.name: ShapeBuild_ReShape
classes.summary:
Rebuilds a Shape by making pre-defined substitutions on some of its components.
In a first phase, it records requests to replace or remove some individual shapes For each shape, the last given request is recorded Requests may be applied "Oriented" (i.e. only to an item with the SAME orientation) or not (the orientation of replacing shape is respectful of that of the original one)
Then, these requests may be applied to any shape which may contain one or more of these individual shapes

instanceMethods.name: Apply
instanceMethods.signature: (shape: TopoDS_Shape, until: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, buildmode: number): TopoDS_Shape
instanceMethods.comment:
Applies the substitutions requests to a shape.
<until> gives the level of type until which requests are taken into account. For subshapes of the type <until> no rebuild and further exploring are done. ACTUALLY, NOT IMPLEMENTED BELOW TopAbs_FACE
<buildmode> says how to do on a SOLID,SHELL ... if one of its sub-shapes has been changed: 0: at least one Replace or Remove -> COMPOUND, else as such 1: at least one Remove (Replace are ignored) -> COMPOUND 2: Replace and Remove are both ignored If Replace/Remove are ignored or absent, the result as same type as the starting shape

instanceMethods.name: Apply
instanceMethods.signature: (theShape: TopoDS_Shape, theUntil: TopAbs_ShapeEnum): TopoDS_Shape
instanceMethods.comment:
Applies the substitutions requests to a shape.
<until> gives the level of type until which requests are taken into account. For subshapes of the type <until> no rebuild and further exploring are done.
NOTE: each subshape can be replaced by shape of the same type or by shape containing only shapes of that type (for example, {@link TopoDS_Edge | `TopoDS_Edge`} can be replaced by {@link TopoDS_Edge | `TopoDS_Edge`}, {@link TopoDS_Wire | `TopoDS_Wire`} or {@link TopoDS_Compound | `TopoDS_Compound`} containing TopoDS_Edges). If incompatible shape type is encountered, it is ignored and flag FAIL1 is set in Status.

instanceMethods.name: Status
instanceMethods.signature: (shape: TopoDS_Shape, newsh: TopoDS_Shape, last: boolean): number

instanceMethods.name: Status
instanceMethods.signature: (status: ShapeExtend_Status): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Queries the status of last call to Apply(shape,enum) OK : no (sub)shapes replaced or removed DONE1: source (starting) shape replaced DONE2: source (starting) shape removed DONE3: some subshapes replaced DONE4: some subshapes removed FAIL1: some replacements not done because of bad type of subshape.

classes.name: ShapeBuild_Vertex
classes.summary: Provides low-level functions used for constructing vertices.

instanceMethods.name: CombineVertex
instanceMethods.signature: (V1: TopoDS_Vertex, V2: TopoDS_Vertex, tolFactor: number): TopoDS_Vertex
instanceMethods.comment: Combines new vertex from two others. This new one is the smallest vertex which comprises both of the source vertices. The function takes into account the positions and tolerances of the source vertices. The tolerance of the new vertex will be equal to the minimal tolerance that is required to comprise source vertices multiplied by tolFactor (in order to avoid errors because of discreteness of calculations).

instanceMethods.name: CombineVertex
instanceMethods.signature: (pnt1: gp_Pnt, pnt2: gp_Pnt, tol1: number, tol2: number, tolFactor: number): TopoDS_Vertex
instanceMethods.comment: The same function as above, except that it accepts two points and two tolerances instead of vertices.
